name: NDTDI
summary: NDTDI, also known as 9-desmethine-LSD, 9-nor-LSD, or 8,10-seco-LSD, is a psychedelic drug related to lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD). It is a tricyclic cyclized tryptamine and partial lysergamide and is a structurally simplified analogue of LSD. The drug is specifically the analogue of LSD in which the carbon atom at position 9 of the ergoline ring system has been removed.

pharmacology.text: It has been reported to produce psychedelic effects similarly to LSD, but with much lower potency.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen; Simplified/partial LSD analogue

uses.text: The pharmacology of NDTDI has not been studied. NDTDI was encountered as a novel designer drug by 2016.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. It has been reported to produce psychedelic effects like those of LSD but much weaker. Psychedelics of this kind can cause anxiety, confusion and a faster heart rate.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。據報告它會產生類似 LSD 但弱得多的迷幻作用。這類迷幻藥可能引起焦慮、混亂與心跳加快。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。据报告它会产生类似 LSD 但弱得多的迷幻作用。这类迷幻药可能引起焦虑、混乱与心跳加快。

fact.en: It is a cut-down version of LSD with one of the four rings of the ergoline skeleton opened up, which is why it is also called 8,10-seco-LSD. Seco means a ring has been cut.
fact.zh: 它是 LSD 的簡化版，把麥角骨架四個環中的一個打開，因此也稱為 8,10-seco-LSD。「seco」在化學命名中就是「環被切開」的意思。
fact.zhHans: 它是 LSD 的简化版，把麦角骨架四个环中的一个打开，因此也称为 8,10-seco-LSD。「seco」在化学命名中就是「环被切开」的意思。
